item.description:
Two classics. One very good dinner. Join us at The Conway Room for a five-course Supper Club celebrating two beloved favorites: fried chicken and oysters. This dinner brings together indulgent comfort and coastal influence, with elevated takes on timeless dishes and plenty of unexpected combinations along the way.
The evening begins with a playful oyster flight featuring preparations like Oyster Rockefeller, a cornmeal-crusted oyster deviled egg, and a chipotle-lime BBQ oyster, followed by a seasonal fall chicory salad. The main event pairs The Conway Room’s fried chicken with smoked Gouda mac and cheese, fire-roasted poblano creamed corn, housemade sauces and habanero pickles, alongside oysters on the half shell with horseradish crème and caviar. And because there’s always room for dessert, we’ll finish with a decadent Death by Chocolate Cake with milk chocolate ganache, espresso-dark chocolate crumb and smoked Maldon salt.

item.title: Evening Compline — Wed Oct 21, 9:00 PM — Saint James Episcopal Church
item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.
Source: Saint James Lancaster

item.title: Challenging Ride (A) - Sunday Worlds (32R) — Sun Oct 18, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Lancaster Bicycle Club (LBC) Meetup Anticipated average pace: **18-20 mph**
Cue and GPX link: [https://ridewithgps.com/routes/45180282](https://ridewithgps.com/routes/45180282)

With Robin Hood-inspired woodwork, a tree growing right through the center, and a heated outdoor bar for crisp October nights, the space is full of charm and character. item.description:
Evening Compline via Zoom Click here to join Compline. (This link can be used for every evening Compline on Zoom.)
The short service of Compline is based on the closing time of prayer in the Daily Office, or monastic cycle of prayer. It is observed in monasteries around 8 or 9 PM when darkness has fallen and bedtime is near.
The thoughts that inspire the prayers during Compline are the need for divine forgiveness and protection against the powers of darkness. Prayers for peace and rest are offered as night falls.
People of all faiths and beliefs are invited to this contemplative service. The service lasts about 20 minutes.

Dr. Robert Frick, historian and presenter, will share the stories and facts related to six events that significantly impacted the United States. The stories of the Great Chicago Fire of 1871, the Johnstown Flood of 1889, the San Francisco Earthquake of 1906, Hurricane Agnes in the Susquehanna Basin in 1972, the Asian Flu Pandemic of 1957-58, and the Sinking of the USS Indianapolis will be shared during this program. Participants should prepare for lively presentations filled with interesting facts and peppered with humor. Dr. Frick’s goal is education with a smile.
